svg.title: Gondor
svg.desc: The White Mountains divide Rohan from southern Gondor. Minas Tirith stands west of Anduin; Osgiliath spans the river. Pelargir lies downstream to the southwest. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The White Mountains · Anórien · the Vale of Anduin
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
